leads.name: No further register or named candidates found in Lagos town itself
leads.reason: This pass searched Lagos's historic parks and gardens (Jardim da Constituicao, Praca Gil Eanes and the old town/castle walls), churches, the ICNF national register (only one entry in the whole concelho: lgp_001), a regional roundup of Algarve monumental trees (algarvevivo.pt), a 'greatest trees of Portugal' listicle (none in the Algarve west of Sao Bras de Alportel, 80km+ away), a local news search on Lagos's own tree-classification process, and a nearby natural-springs park (Sitio das Fontes, which turned out to be in neighbouring Lagoa municipality, not Lagos, and does not name individual trees anyway). A November 2019 Lagos Municipal Assembly motion asked the council to survey the whole municipality for classification-worthy trees; no evidence was found that this survey produced a published list, so Lagos may simply be a 'nobody has named its trees' city per the pattern in BRIEF_RESEARCH.md. Next pass should try: the parish churches by name (Igreja de Santo Antonio, Igreja de Sao Sebastiao, Igreja Santa Maria), Ponta da Piedade cliff walks, and a direct query/email-style check of the Camara Municipal de Lagos rather than press coverage.
